pick.headline: Russia, Ukraine and Belarus agree to dissolve the USSR
pick.summary: On December 8, 1991, the leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus, meeting at Belovezha near Brest, declared that the Soviet Union had ceased to exist and formed the Commonwealth of Independent States.
pick.significance: The agreement ended the Soviet Union in all but name; Gorbachev resigned seventeen days later.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of December 9, 1991, carried Moscow TASS in English on Japan's cautious reaction to the Slavic leaders' statement ending the Soviet Union, with Tokyo sending a special envoy to Moscow and Kiev.

alternates.headline: Reagan and Gorbachev sign the INF Treaty
alternates.summary: On December 8, 1987, Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev signed the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty in Washington.
alternates.significance: The treaty eliminated an entire class of nuclear missiles, with intrusive on-site inspections that broke new ground in verification.
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of December 8, 1987, carried Prague CTK in English: Polednik and World Peace Council chairman Chandra stressed the historic significance of the Washington summit and the treaty eliminating medium- and shorter-range missiles.
